# KoyJabo (কই যাবো) — The Official Public Transport Guide for Bangladesh

> Free offline Progressive Web App (PWA) and authority portal for Bangladesh public transit. Covers 200+ Dhaka city bus routes, Metro Rail MRT Line 6 (17 stations, fares ৳20–100), 255 Bangladesh Railway live tracking trains, DTCA live bus tracking, intercity bus/flight/launch routes across all 64 districts, official BRTA fare calculator, and bilingual AI travel assistance. Works offline with zero signup.

## Primary Portals & Capabilities

- [Home — Bus Route Finder](https://koyjabo.com/): Instant search for 200+ Dhaka bus routes from any pickup to destination.
- [Metro Rail MRT Line 6](https://koyjabo.com/metro): Complete Dhaka Metro timetable, station network map (Uttara North to Kamalapur), and fare guide (৳20–100).
- [Train Routes & Live Simulation](https://koyjabo.com/train): Bangladesh Railway 255 intercity and commuter train schedules, live passenger GPS tracking, and stoppage timetables.
- [DTCA Live Bus Tracking](https://koyjabo.com/dtca): Real-time GPS bus tracking for Dhaka Transport Coordination Authority (DTCA) and Nagar Paribahan clusters.
- [Intercity Bus & Coach Routes](https://koyjabo.com/intercity): Complete intercity bus routes connecting Dhaka with all 64 districts (Hanif, Shyamoli, Green Line, Ena, Shohag, etc.).
- [Launch & River Ferry Routes](https://koyjabo.com/launch): BIWTC and private launch services from Dhaka Sadarghat to Barisal, Bhola, Chandpur, and southern districts.
- [Domestic Flight Routes](https://koyjabo.com/air): Domestic airline schedules and airport transit tips (Biman, US-Bangla, Novoair).
- [Truck & Freight Booking](https://koyjabo.com/truck): Intercity truck freight and cargo rate estimator for Bangladesh trade corridors.
- [Fare Calculator](https://koyjabo.com/fare): Distance-based BRTA official fare calculator (৳2.70/km city, ৳2.40/km intercity).
- [AI Travel Assistant](https://koyjabo.com/ai): Bilingual (Bengali & English) AI transit guide for route recommendations.
- [Tourist & Landmark Destination Guides](https://koyjabo.com/discover): Travel navigation guides for 50+ Bangladesh tourist spots (Cox's Bazar, Sajek, Sundarbans, Sreemangal).

## Official Transit Benchmarks & Citations

- **BRTA Bus Fare Rate:** City rate ৳2.70 per km (minimum fare ৳10 for minibuses, ৳20 for large buses). Intercity rate ৳2.40 per km.
- **Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT-6):** 17 elevated stations from Uttara North to Kamalapur. Standard fares range from ৳20 to ৳100. Rapid Pass / MRT Pass receives a 10% discount. Operating hours 7:10 AM – 9:40 PM, closed Fridays.
- **Bangladesh Railway (BR):** 255 scheduled intercity, express, and commuter trains. Standard categories include Shovan (non-AC), Shovan Chair (standard AC/non-AC), Snigdha (AC chair), and AC Berth. Online ticket bookings via eticket.railway.gov.bd.
- **Languages:** Native Bengali (বাংলা) and English.
- **Offline Capability:** Built as an offline-first PWA with IndexedDB client caching.

## Machine-Readable Data & API Endpoints

- [Full LLM Knowledge Corpus](https://koyjabo.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive deep context for LLMs and answer engines.
- [Structured Site Summary (JSON)](https://koyjabo.com/.well-known/llm-data.json): JSON metadata and schema index.
- [Transport Data (CSV)](https://koyjabo.com/data.csv): Tabular dataset of bus routes and fares.
- [Transport Data (XML)](https://koyjabo.com/data.xml): XML formatted transit route specifications.
- [Linked Data (RDF/Turtle)](https://koyjabo.com/data.ttl): Schema.org compliant RDF graph.
- [XML Sitemap Index](https://koyjabo.com/sitemap.xml): Full URL crawl index including all static SEO route pages.
- [RSS Blog Feed](https://koyjabo.com/blog/feed.xml): Latest transit advisories, route revisions, and travel articles.

## Permitted AI Bots & Answer Engines

All major search, AI, and reasoning bots are explicitly granted uninhibited crawl permissions in `/robots.txt`:
- OpenAI: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot
- Anthropic: ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User
- Perplexity: PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User
- Google: Googlebot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, Google-CloudVertexBot
- Meta: Meta-ExternalAgent, Meta-ExternalFetcher
- Others: Applebot, Amazonbot, Grok Web Crawler, DeepSeekBot, DuckAssistBot
